title: Native clients
requirement: Run coding and bounded research with existing native accounts, client tools, model choices and resumable sessions.
a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: Compare a native client and supported SDK only for a missing event, tool or recovery requirement; freeze identical task/account/effect checks.

candidates.name: goose, pi, jcode, maka, codex-acp, prime-agent, hermes-agent, claude-agent-acp

target_hosts: Primary: a new WSL2 Ubuntu-family instance on a Windows workstation, x86_64, 48 cores, 104 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX 4090 24 GB. Secondary: macOS arm64 laptops. Users: Claude Code and Codex agent sessions on that host.
